notes: Independent fee audit of all 15 records supplied by discovery (10) and diamond expansion (5). Result: 12 verified_free, three needs_verification; no universal zero-cost claim is made for the Springer or Cambridge routes.

The audit separately considered submission, publication/APC, page/length, mandatory membership/registration and other compulsory costs. Paid OA, requested print color, offprints, editing services and copyright permissions are distinguished from ordinary compliant publication. External reuse or service choices can create costs even at a fee-free journal.

Meta-Psychology was upgraded because its current official completely-free/no-processing-fees language is a blanket journal-cost statement. Interpreting that wording as covering submission is explicitly identified in the patch; it is not inferred from absence of an APC alone.

Judgment and Decision Making currently uses paid Gold OA and Cambridge-assessed postacceptance waiver/discount routes. A discount may still leave an author payment; institutional and geographic funding are conditional. Although browser fee-page retrieval timed out, ordinary urllib returned HTTP 200 and the full current official fee section, confirming GBP 2610/USD 3655 plus possible taxes. The full official OA-options page was also directly read.

Psychological Research and Memory & Cognition have verified standard subscription APC exemptions, but a specific submission-fee/all-compulsory-cost exclusion remained unresolved. Springer’s general statement is qualified to most subscription journals and is not sufficient to mark either route fully verified.

PsychOpen GOLD currently announces discontinuation by 31 December 2027 (https://psychopen.eu/). Methodology, Social Psychological Bulletin and QCMB are currently covered by its no-submission/no-publication-fee policy. No successor-publisher fees or future submission availability are established. Psychological Thought has been university-operated since January 2020.

Rechecked excluded paused leads: Journal of Numerical Cognition currently pauses submissions during a publisher move and its notice says PsychOpen journal support ceases in September 2027, which is earlier than the platform-wide 31 December 2027 closure notice (https://jnc.psychopen.eu/). Europe’s Journal of Psychology remains paused for new manuscripts from 18 February 2026 until further notice (https://ejop.psychopen.eu/). Journal of Social and Political Psychology remains paused from 4 May 2026 and announces a move to Universidad de O’Higgins with reopening planned early in 2027, not an already reopened portal (https://jspp.psychopen.eu/). They are not added as currently available candidates.

Preserved Social Psychological Bulletin’s prohibition of original AI-written text even with disclosure (https://spb.psychopen.eu/index.php/spb/author-policies) and Theory & Psychology’s explicit editorial-permission requirement for disclosed AI-generated text/visuals (https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/tap). Fee verification does not grant workflow permission or scientific suitability.

No login, manuscript submission, venue contact or remote write was performed. Fee status is a bounded current policy reading; article-specific limits, rights, research ethics and eventual acceptance remain separate requirements.
